product_flow.name: Fishing rods and other line fishing tackle, fish landing nets, butterfly nets and similar nets, decoy "birds" and similar hunting or shooting requisites

required_qualifiers: actual site and reporting period
complete configured rod BOM and revision
non-telescopic carbon thermoset-epoxy structure and actual section/joint configuration
whole prepreg supplied state and supplier fibre/resin/finish boundary
whole guide and tip-top frames/rings supplied once
complete reel-seat hardware and no reel/line/hooks/baits supplied
actual EVA grip and butt closure inclusions
actual cutting/rolling/tape/cure/trim/sanding/coating/branding/assembly conditions
actual whole adhesive/coating/cleaning formulations and disjoint mixing subaccounts
manufacturer-required whole-rod inspections and acceptance/disposition
calibrated complete net rod mass and actual moisture/configuration
unique first-release cohort Q and release history
raw/WIP/non-WIP stores and complete per-exchange inherited vectors
released FG history and original service Q_c/H without new Q
full gross packaging P/I/ER/S/EO/W pools and upstream owner
actual assets/new and used repair parts/installed fluid and moisture bridges
actual utility supplier geography/voltage/delivery carrier and enthalpy
real molecular gas phases/sources/receiving media and actual waste outlets
complete native family restrictions in each selected card
unresolved identities/providers/quantities and uncertainty disclosed

full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: Q = sum of calibrated net complete rod masses newly first quality-released in the declared cohort. Weigh accepted whole rods with all configured sections and fitted parts, excluding detachable transport packaging and excluded fishing equipment; retain tare/calibration, moisture and configuration records. Counts use independently measured same-configuration net masses, never nominal supplier mass or a secondary native factor.

Released closing FG already belongs to Q; manufacturing burden closing stores contain only raw/WIP and genuinely unused/unassigned non-WIP burden. Delivery/retesting/returns are not new production. First-release Q is not a net-delivery denominator.

Preserve each actual native extensive property and numerator unit. Convert measured kWh to MJ once by the exact factor 3.6. Integrated liquid/gas volumes are cumulative; integrate only actual rates. Volume-to-mass needs independently measured density of that material at its true composition/state, not water density or a secondary flow-property factor. Count Item(s) and item are equivalent by factor 1; no kg/item is inferred.

For every gross card A_i = actual complete event V_i in its own unit, with no stock correction, burden-vector substitution or economic share. Its Y_i is a physical disclosure, not an additional upstream procurement or credit. The same event owner’s actual burden dimension is attributed once separately.

Collect original raw records without division. In protocol tables aggregation_rule labels the final per-reference view only; the raw collection method and raw_fields remain unnormalised. Prepare the applicable numerator first and execute the single_quotient rule exactly once. Amount fields and aggregation labels point to that same saved result and never divide again.

For Q_c = 0 preserve all real loads, stocks, failures and disposition; issue no unit result. Unknown quantities/balances/service capacity stay unresolved. Q_c is the measured original cohort reference mass for a service account, not present shipment mass or a fabricated future quantity.

calculationRules.rule: Convert only true original units: MJ = 3.6 * measured_kWh; kg_i = cumulative_volume_i * independently_measured_density_i_at_actual_state. Integrate a genuine rate once over its matched observed time, whereas a cumulative meter/integrated volume is not multiplied by time. Keep carrier mass/enthalpy and relevant constituent mass disjoint from their whole supply owner.

For each original exchange dimension retain the full inherited vectors. Manufacturing attributable A_i = B_open_i + U_i - B_close_i - justified_T_other_i, with B_close limited to raw/WIP/genuinely unused or unassigned non-WIP stores. Use an already stock-corrected U directly without subtracting stores again. For original-cohort service A_i contains all actual consumed/performed burden through H plus inherited assigned burden; defer only genuinely unused/unassigned capacity/charge burden. Released FG is not B_close. Ordinary waste/sale is not T_other. These burden dimensions are not the physical numerators of gross cards.

A_i = V_i, the full actual independently measured gross physical event in that card’s own native unit. Never substitute B_open + U - B_close, service burden, a coproduct/economic share or net shipments. Its disclosed physical Y_i creates no extra procurement/provider/credit. The same real event’s upstream or service burden is owned and attributed once as a distinct burden dimension.

Opening_empty + Opening_attached_WIP_FG + Opening_reusable + P + I + ER + actual_disjoint_repair_or_moisture_in = Closing_empty + Closing_attached_WIP_FG + Closing_reusable + gross_S + EO + W_raw + actual_disjoint_moisture_or_material_out. Internal reuse/handoffs cancel once. Whole wet P/I and their water/components are not added twice. X_in/X_out remove only overlapping other incoming/outgoing flow terms on the same side, never a stock or the opposite physical leg; new retained influx and complete closing wet mass both remain. For one mixed outlet sum non-overlapping origin W_raw only to the measured whole mixture and assign its treatment/provider once.

For each disjoint physical material and relevant element use actual opening mass + actual gross incoming + independently evidenced reaction/source terms = actual closing mass + actual gross outgoing. Manufacture includes Q as its internal first-release handoff; FG includes the matching Q receipt; consolidation cancels them once. Keep water absorbed/evaporated in ordinary storage, carrier returns, retained installed fluids, failures and actual losses. Reaction/free/phase/structural water need separate independent evidence; one fitted residual cannot establish multiple unknowns. This physical equation is never scaled by burden allocation shares.

Y_i = A_i / Q_c. A_i is the prepared raw numerator of the selected dimension; gross cards use complete V_i, burden dimensions use only their justified attributable vector, and the reference row uses its own Q. Q_c is positive measured first-release cohort mass or the linked original cohort mass for actual service. Execute once and store Y_i; card Amount fields and protocol aggregation labels refer to this same saved result without another division. With Q_c = 0 retain raw loads/stocks and issue no unit result.

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Match the actual complete rod BOM, supply state and every hard native material/form/phase/route/grade/geography/media/type restriction; a UUID or catalogue weight alone is insufficient. Keep unresolved ordinary auxiliary identities explicit.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Supplier technical records; original native identity; controlled drawings; incoming/first-release inspection

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Retain original non-divided measurements with units, uncertainty, calibration, tare, density/state and rate/integral distinction; no nominal rod mass or composition inferred from a conversion coefficient.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Raw scale/meter records; calibration; material-state tests; calculation trail

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Account every failure, zero-output period, start/stop, cleanup, test, rejected and attempted rework load with opening/closing raw/WIP/non-WIP physical and every inherited exchange vector. No second stock correction or released-FG manufacture deduction.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Lot/serial history; stock-state ledgers; complete source-vector provenance

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Identify original Q_c, observed H and actual performed work independently of FG dispatch. Continued qualification requires permission/spec and post-work tests/acceptance; performed unauthorized/failed work remains recorded with real hold/waste disposition.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Service-time/driver records; manufacturer decisions; tests; disposition register

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Verify each actual packaging six-leg pool and full wet stocks, whole supplied-article and disjoint repair/moisture bridges, new/used asset/part events, installed fluid and consumed capacity burden. Check every card description for wrong inherited identities; pallet is not plank, PE not PET, film not resin, whole guide not a ring alone.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Matched gross event IDs; measured component origins; physical balances; upstream owner links

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Document subdivision, each determining physical cause and any genuinely residual same-gate contemporaneous market values; prove full vector conservation. Waste sale/external transfer does not itself justify T_other or a credit.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Causal driver evidence; common-gate states/prices; receiver handover; conserved vectors

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Use complete relevant originals and context; distinguish product-route examples from measured plant data and allocation methodology. No supplier’s numeric recipe or operating example becomes a universal default.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Primary technical originals; source-specific applicability and limitations; complete context

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Instantiate all actual exchanges, provider boundaries and real species/outlets before claiming completeness; disclose missing quantities/providers/composition and uncertainty. Ordinary gaps do not prove absent manufacture, and failed retrieval does not prove absence in a database.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: Complete actual BOM/route/meter/outlet reconciliation and unresolved-gap register

measurementRules.rule: Q = 声明 cohort 中经校准的完整新首次质量放行净竿质量之和。称量含全部配置竿节/已装件的合格整竿，排除可拆运输包装及被排除钓具，保留皮重/校准、含水和配置记录。计数换算须独立实测同配置净质量，不用供方标重或次级原生系数。
已放行期末 FG 已属 Q；制造负荷期末储存仅含原料/在制及真正未用/未分配非在制负荷。交付/重验/返还不造新产量，首次放行 Q 不是净交付分母。

measurementRules.required_property: 实际行声明的广延属性
measurementRules.rule: 保留每种真实原生广延属性和分子单位。实测 kWh 按精确因子3.6换 MJ 一次。积分气/液体积已累计，仅真实速率才积分。体积换质量须独立实测该物质真实组成/状态密度，不套水密度或次级流属性系数。Item(s) 与 item 以因子1等价，不推定 kg/item。
每张毛卡 A_i = 以自身单位表示的真实完整事件 V_i，不作库存修正、不替换负荷向量、不乘经济份额。Y_i 为实物披露，不是额外上游采购或信用；同一事件 owner 的真实负荷维度另归属一次。

measurementRules.required_property: 协议声明的未归一化原始广延数量
measurementRules.rule: 原始记录采集不作除法。协议表 aggregation_rule 仅标最终每参考视图，collection_method/raw_fields 仍为未归一原始采集。先准备适用分子，再执行 single_quotient 一次；数量字段/聚合标签指向同一已存结果，绝不再除。
Q_c = 0 时保留全部真实负荷、库存、失败与处置，不出单位结果。未知数量/平衡/服务容量保持未解决。服务账 Q_c 为实测原 cohort 参考质量，不是当前发运质量或编造未来量。

calculationRules.rule: 仅换算真实原单位：MJ = 3.6 * measured_kWh；kg_i = cumulative_volume_i * independently_measured_density_i_at_actual_state。真正速率按配套实测时间积分一次，累计仪表/积分体积不再乘时间。载体质量/焓和相关组分质量与整份供货 owner 分账且不重复。

每个原交换维度保留完整继承向量。制造归属 A_i = B_open_i + U_i - B_close_i - justified_T_other_i，其中 B_close 仅原料/在制/真实未用或未分配非在制储存。已修正库存的 U 直接用，不再次扣存。原 cohort 服务 A_i 含截至 H 全部真实耗用/已发生负荷及已归属继承负荷，仅真实未用/未分配容量/介质负荷递延。已放行 FG 不是 B_close，普通废物/出售不是 T_other。此负荷维度不作毛卡的实物分子。
A_i = V_i，即该卡自身原生单位下独立实测的真实完整毛实物事件。绝不替换成 B_open + U - B_close、服务负荷、共产品/经济份额或净发运。披露实物 Y_i 不再产生采购/供方/信用；同一事件上游/服务负荷作为独立负荷维度由 owner 一次归属。

Opening_empty + Opening_attached_WIP_FG + Opening_reusable + P + I + ER + actual_disjoint_repair_or_moisture_in = Closing_empty + Closing_attached_WIP_FG + Closing_reusable + gross_S + EO + W_raw + actual_disjoint_moisture_or_material_out。内部复用/交接抵消一次。整份湿 P/I 及其水/组分不二计。X_in/X_out 仅去同侧其他流入/出项重叠，不去库存或对侧实物腿；新增留存入流与期末完整湿质量同时保留。单一混合出口仅将不重叠来源 W_raw 对到实测整份混合物，其处理/供方一次归属。

calculationRules.applies_to: 制造/成品库/合并实物门
calculationRules.rule: 每个不重叠物料及相关元素使用真实期初质量 + 实际毛流入 + 独立证实反应/源项 = 实际期末质量 + 实际毛流出。制造包含 Q 内部首次放行交接，FG 含匹配 Q 接收，合并抵消一次。保留普通仓储吸/失水、载体回水、在装流体保留、失败及真实损失。反应/游离/相态/结构水须各有独立依据，一个拟合残差不证多个未知。实物方程绝不按负荷分配份额缩量。
Y_i = A_i / Q_c。A_i 为选定维度已准备原始分子：毛卡用完整 V_i，负荷维度仅用正当归属向量，参考行用自身 Q。Q_c 为正的实测首次放行 cohort 质量或实际服务链接原 cohort 质量。只执行一次并存 Y_i，卡数量字段及协议聚合标签指同一已存结果，不再除。Q_c = 0 时保留原负荷/库存，不出单位结果。

collectionProtocols.raw_fields: 序号; 型号; 配置; 完整BOM; 实际节数; 净竿质量kg; 含水状态; 皮重; 校准; 检查试验; 唯一首次放行决定; cohort_Q; 期初FG; 期末已放行FG; 返还历史
collectionProtocols.collection_method: 使用经校准秤称量真实配置的合格完整竿，排除可拆运输包装及排除钓具；全竿节/已装部件与受控 BOM、唯一首次放行决定核对。真实净放行质量求和一次为 Q。若用计数，独立称同真实配置样品并留抽样不确定性，不用目录重。采集仍为未除原始量。

collectionProtocols.flow_role: 不重叠实物存量和水/物种
collectionProtocols.raw_fields: 真实过程门; 原料_在制_非在制_资产_FG池; 期初; 完整湿期末; 组成; 完工程度; 实际毛入出; 内部成对交接; P_I_ER_S_EO_W; 反应证据; X_in_out; 实际物种; 水相; 来源cohort
collectionProtocols.collection_method: 独立量测完整实物期初/末池及每个真实流入/出事件，新入保留料/水与期末完整湿库存同时保留。以物种/相态/反应及元素观测确认，不拟残差。X 仅去同侧另一流项重叠。整件/组分交接以不重叠成对桥记录，内部 Q 抵消一次。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留未除的原始测量及单位、不确定性、校准、皮重、密度/状态和速率/累计区别，不从换算系数推标称竿质量或配方。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 原秤/仪表记录；校准；物态测试；计算链

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 每个失败、零产出期、启停、清理、试验、不合格及尝试重工负荷均对应期初/末原料/在制/非在制实物及逐交换继承向量，不二次修正库存或扣已放行 FG 制造负荷。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 批次/序号历史；库存状态账；完整源向量来源

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 独立于 FG 发运标识原 Q_c、观测 H 和真实已发生作业。持续合格须许可/规范和事后试验/放行；已发生未许可/失败作业仍按真实待处置/废物保留。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 服务时间/驱动记录；制造商决定；试验；处置登记

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 核对每个真实包装六腿池/完整湿库存、整供货桥及不重叠维修/水桥、新旧资产/部件事件、在装流体和已耗容量负荷。逐卡查错继承身份，托盘不是木板、PE 不是 PET、膜不是树脂、整导环不是单环。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 匹配毛事件 ID；实测组分来源；实物平衡；上游 owner 链

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 记录细分、每项确定性物理因果及真实余项同门同期市值，证明完整向量守恒。废物出售/外送本身不支持 T_other 或信用。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 因果驱动依据；共门状态/价格；接受方移交；守恒向量

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 使用完整相关原件及上下文，区分产品路线实例、实测工厂数据和分配方法。供方数字配方/操作实例不升为通用默认。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 主要技术原件；来源特定适用性/限制；完整上下文

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 声称完整前实例化全部真实交换、供方边界和物种/出口，披露缺量/供方/组成及不确定性。普通缺口不证明制造不存在，查询失败不证明数据库不存在。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整真实 BOM/路线/仪表/出口核对及未决登记
